text:
Joel Farabee arrived in Calgary as part of the Flyers deal, and this season he is giving the Flames a reason to talk about it. He has 17 points in 21 games, nine on the power play, and he scored in the overtime comeback against Philadelphia on Nov. 8, the night headlines from Sportsnet to Markerzone wrote about his complete game and his old team's side of the trade.

The best part is that the chances are his. His own shots are worth 7.6 expected goals (the quality of his chances), up to 1.14 per 60 from 0.71 last season, and seven goals on that is honest finishing, not a hot streak. He is playing 19:06 a night, and Calgary is 3.31 points better in expected goal share with him on than off.

The points pace, 2.54 per 60, is ahead of his talent range, so expect it to settle somewhat even if the chances hold. He has gone pointless in three straight since that night. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 61% of his shots coming off the rush last season, so watch the transition game when the Flames win the puck back.
headline: Joel Farabee is making the trade look good for Calgary
